entries.name: VES Hospital (Veterinary Emergency and Specialty Hospital)
entries.duty: Open 24 hours daily for emergencies and critical care. Call ahead on the way.
entries.note: Licensed per NParks/AVS register (as VES Hospital, 232 Whitley Road). 24 h: mustsharenews article lists 'opening hours: 24 hours daily'; Yahoo article (malaysia.news.yahoo.com ...ves-hospital-singapore) says '24/7 emergency and critical care' at VES@Whitley. Phone 6266 0232 from sosd.org.sg/?p=16769 (older sources also list a Rochdale Road site, 6581 7028, not in the 2026 register). veshospital.com.sg could not be opened via WebFetch (provenance block), skipped.

entries.name: Westside Veterinary Emergency and Referral Hospital
entries.duty: 24-hour emergency veterinary clinic. Call ahead.
entries.note: In NParks register (86 Serangoon Garden Way). knineculture.com page: 'a dedicated 24-hour emergency veterinary clinic'. Phone from sosd.org.sg/?p=16769 (wonderwall.sg shows a mixed-up address/phone). Own site could not be opened (WebFetch provenance block), skipped.

entries.name: Beecroft Animal Specialist and Emergency Hospital
entries.duty: Emergency and critical care department open 24 hours a day.
entries.note: Own site (beecroftsg.squarespace.com) opened: 'Our Emergency & Critical Care (ECC) department operates 24 hours a day.' Address from NParks register; phone from sosd.org.sg/?p=16769; beecroft.com.sg itself not openable.

entries.name: Advanced VetCare Veterinary Centre (Bedok)
entries.address: 26 Jalan Pari Burong, Picardy Gardens, Singapore 488692
entries.duty: Offers care 24 hours a day, including emergency and critical care.
entries.note: about.me/advancedvetcare (clinic's own profile) opened: 'care 24 hours a day', 24-hour emergency and critical care. Address from NParks register. Phone 6636 1788 from sosd.org.sg; an older article gives 6697 5322 at 18 Jalan Pari Burong. knineculture: 'uninterrupted emergency and critical care throughout the year'. advancedvetcare.sg not openable. Other branches in register: 283 Outram Road, 564A Balestier Road, 271 Bukit Timah Road (no phone found).

entries.name: Companion Animal Surgery
entries.duty: Open 24 hours; day clinic plus night clinic.
entries.note: expatliving.sg page lists '(open 24 hours)'; wonderwall.sg lists day clinic 0830-2100 and night clinic 2100-0830; knineculture: 'a full-service 24-hour facility'. Address per NParks register. comvet.com not openable.

entries.name: Landon Veterinary Specialist Hospital (Pet A&E)
entries.address: 41 Eng Kong Terrace, Eng Kong Park, Singapore 599013
entries.duty: Emergency service (Pet A&E); call ahead for current hours.
entries.note: sosd.org.sg lists it as emergency vet but gives no hours; no page stating 24 h was opened, so emergency_24h false. Address in NParks register. lvs.com.sg not openable. Checker: thesmartlocal.com/read/24-hour-vets-singapore lists it under 'Open 24 Hours' but says it mostly admits by appointment with a Pet A&E for urgent cases; not explicit enough, kept false. Phone 6463 7228 confirmed on sosd.org.sg.

entries.name: Animal Wellness Referral Centre
entries.address: 200 Bukit Timah Road, Atland House, #01-01, Singapore 229862
entries.duty: Referral and specialist hospital; call ahead.
entries.note: Phone from thesmartlocal.com listing (aggregator, phone only); address in NParks register. No 24 h statement opened. awrc.sg not openable. Checker 2026-11-10: thesmartlocal listing labels it '24 Hour Vet' but its own text gives Mon/Tue/Wed/Fri/Sat 9:00-03:00, Thu/Sun 9:00-19:00 and says night clinic operates till 12am only (contradictory), so emergency_24h stays false. Phone 6530 3530 confirmed.

entries.name: Mount Pleasant Veterinary Centre (Gelenggang)
entries.address: 2 Jalan Gelenggang, Sembawang Hills Estate, Singapore 578187
entries.duty: Call for opening hours and emergency arrangements.
entries.note: Register confirms address (Mount Pleasant Veterinary Centre (2008)). Phone from expatliving.sg and wonderwall.sg. knineculture says group has a '24-hour tertiary care center'; newswire.com (2015) says Mount Pleasant emergency centre at Whitley Road is round-the-clock; no page opened states 24 h for this branch. Other Mount Pleasant branches in register: East Coast Road, Yishun, Bedok, Clementi, Farrer (no phones found). mountpleasant.com.sg not openable.

notes: Most clinics' own websites (veshospital.com.sg, westsideemergency.com.sg, advancedvetcare.sg, comvet.com, lvs.com.sg, mountpleasant.com.sg etc.) could not be fetched by the tool (provenance block), so 24-h claims rest on opened news/directory pages and should be verified by the checker. No Singapore animal poison line found (searches only returned AU/US services). No duty rota exists. Animal Recovery Veterinary Referral Centre (466 Serangoon Road, 6252 2623), Animal Infirmary and Doctors Beck & Stone are not in the 2026 NParks register and were left out. Remaining register clinics (~100) have no phone/url found and are not included. 24-h from third-party pages: VES, Westside, Companion Animal Surgery, Advanced VetCare; Beecroft from own site.
